items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Buccaneers waived S Ja'Qurious Conley.
items.impact: Conley was waived with a non-football injury designation. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Ja'Qurious Conley waived by Bucs

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chiefs DE Ethan Downs tore the ACL in his left knee.
items.impact: Downs was competing for a depth role as an EDGE rusher. He'll miss the entire season.
items.title: Ethan Downs suffers torn ACL

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said Jermod McCoy will be ready to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: McCoy fell in the NFL Draft this year due to concerns over a previous knee injury. He will get reps early, with the team planning to adjust his workload as needed.
items.title: Jermod McCoy (knee) ready to practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants activated Thomas Fidone II from the PUP list.
items.impact: Fidone will be available to return to practice this week after starting training camp on the PUP list.
items.title: Thomas Fidone II (foot) activated from PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants activated Sam Roberts from the PUP list.
items.impact: Roberts will be available to return to practice this week after starting training camp on the PUP list.
items.title: Sam Roberts activated from PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Saints coach Kellen Moore said it was an offseason tibia surgery for Mason Tipton.
items.impact: Tipton has missed time in the Saints offseason program as he recovers from the surgery.
items.title: Mason Tipton underwent offseason tibia surgery

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers signed DE KJ Henry.
items.impact: Henry had a successful workout with San Francisco. He'll compete for a depth role on its defensive line.
items.title: KJ Henry signs with 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jamal Hill is reportedly making good recovery from offseason wrist ligament surgery.
items.impact: Hill was able to maintain training, practice schedule with a cast on. He will be competing for a depth role.
items.title: Jamal Hill (wrist) making positive recovery

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Braden Smith is on track to be ready for training camp.
items.impact: Smith has outpaced his original rehab schedule after offseason neck surgery. He is expected to be eased back into practices.
items.title: Braden Smith (neck) on track for training camp

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Saints GM Mickey Loomis said Jordyn Tyson had a reoccurrence of the hamstring issue before they drafted him.
items.impact: Terrell notes that they didn't seem worried about the injuries. He'll be monitored early in training camp.
items.title: Jordyn Tyson to have hamstring issues monitored in training camp

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Titans coach Robert Saleh said Will Levis can compete with Mitch Trubisky for No. 2 QB job.
items.impact: This will be a situation to monitor throughout training camp and into the preseason. Titans GM Mike Borgonzi said rostering third QB is a matter of the best 53 players.
items.title: Mitchell Trubisky to compete with Will Levis for QB2 job

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders hosted WR Dee Eskridge for a workout on Tuesday.
items.impact: Eskridge was one of four wide receivers at Tuesday's tryout. Washington remains likely to sign another wide receiver before the start of the season.
items.title: Dee Eskridge works out for Commanders Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders hosted WR River Cracraft for a workout on Tuesday.
items.impact: Cracraft was one of four wide receivers at Tuesday's tryout. Washington remains likely to sign another wide receiver before the start of the season.
items.title: River Cracraft works out for Commanders Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kain Medrano is dealing with a hamstring injury that will force him to miss the start of training camp.
items.impact: It is not believed to be a long-term issue for Medrano.
items.title: Kain Medrano (hamstring) to miss some time

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Commanders GM Adam Peters said he believes the David Blough offense will be more QB friendly for Jayden Daniels.
items.impact: Peters added he believes Daniels will have more options in the new offense under Blough. He'll be looking to bounce back after he was limited to just seven games due to injuries last season.
items.title: Jayden Daniels: OC David Blough expected to run QB friendly offense

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants signed DT Marlon Davidson.
items.impact: Davidson was on a tryout at Giants minicamp last month in June. He will compete for a depth role on the Giants defensive line.
items.title: Marlon Davidson signs with Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers are signing Quinton Bell to a one-year contract.
items.impact: Bell was previously with the Dolphins. He'll add depth to the linebacker room for San Francisco.
items.title: Quinton Bell signs with 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders signed P Matt Haack.
items.impact: Haack earns a spot in training camp with Washington while Tress Way (pec) misses some time.
items.title: Matt Haack signs with Commanders
